title: orthosiphon macrophyllus
intro: Orthosiphon macrophyllus, commonly known as Miswak or Java tea, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving headaches and body aches, and supporting kidney function. The plant's therapeutic actions include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in managing urinary tract infections, high blood pressure, and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Orthosiphon macrophyllus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
